description: Fully-connected feedforward network. Learns arbitrary non-linear feature interactions via stacked affine+activation layers.

math.backprop: dL/dW^(l) via chain rule; weight updates: w <- w - lr * grad
math.activation: ReLU(z) = max(0, z) — avoids vanishing gradient vs sigmoid
math.batch_norm: BN(x) = (x - mu_B) / sqrt(sigma_B^2 + eps) * gamma + beta — stabilizes training by re-centering activations per mini-batch
math.dropout: Randomly zero out p fraction of neurons during training — implicit ensemble regularization

assumptions: Sufficient training data to fit parameters without memorizing
Feature distribution roughly stationary across flights
Rolling statistics already capture temporal context — point-in-time prediction suffices
Gradients don't vanish with ReLU + BatchNorm

training.nan_strategy: drop rows with any NaN in features
training.validation_flight: log_52 (held out from training for val loss monitoring)
training.test_flight: log_54 (never seen during training or HP tuning)
